sentences.text: In nineteen eighty-one, a family rented Cabin twenty-eight in the California pines.
April eleventh was pitch black and completely silent.
Around midnight, the outside phone wire was cut cleanly in two.
Someone entered through the front door without breaking a single lock.
The living room lights were turned off, and the curtains drawn shut.
In the morning, the oldest daughter walked home from next door.
She opened the door to a scene of total devastation.
Three victims lay motionless on the wooden floor.
Yet in the back bedroom, three young boys were left unharmed.
They had heard muffled whispers in the dark, but saw only shadows.
Then police noticed twelve-year-old Tina was missing.
Three years later, her remains were discovered thirty miles away in the forest.
Over four decades later, Cabin twenty-eight has been demolished.
And the intruders in the dark were never caught.
